findings.issue_summary: Foreground services are declared correctly but require Play Console declarations.
findings.evidence: WearableStreamingService and PlaybackService are declared as foreground services in AndroidManifest.xml, and startForeground() is called in WearableStreamingService.kt.
findings.recommendation: Play Console Declaration Required: For apps targeting Android 14+, you must complete a Foreground Service declaration in the Play Console (App content section) for each type used, providing a functional description, user impact video, and a specific use case selection.

findings.issue_summary: App requests broad RECORD_AUDIO permission for occasional, user-initiated vocal input or short recording.
findings.evidence: MainActivity.kt requests RECORD_AUDIO. WearableStreamingService.kt line 185 uses AudioRecord to record audio, triggered by user interaction. App targets SDK 37.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to the Android Microphone Button API to process temporary audio securely.
